abstract: Three cases of intrapulmonary teratoma are described. A specific symptom of trichoptysis occurred in two patients. The other presented with only recurrent hemoptysis. All were treated by lobectomy of the affected lung. Pathologic examination in each specimen showed that the tumor had a cystic portion which was connected to the bronchial system and contained sebaceous material and pieces of hair. The solid portion consisted of tissues representing all three germ cell layers. The pathologic findings correlated well with the clinical symptoms and radiologic findings in the patients.
abstract_ja: 肺内奇形腫の3例を報告する。2例に喀毛という特徴的な症状がみられ、1例は反復性喀血のみを呈した。全例で患側肺の肺葉切除術を施行した。病理標本では、気管支系と連続する嚢胞部を認め、皮脂様物質と毛髪が含まれていた。充実部は三胚葉すべての組織から構成されていた。病理所見は臨床症状や画像所見とよく一致した。
